job.question: Under Missouri LAGERS' private markets consultant RFP, how many public fund clients of what minimum size must a respondent provide non-discretionary private market investment consulting to?
job.expected_facts: At least three public fund clients with assets of at least $10 billion (as of March 31, 2024).
job.acceptance: At least three public-fund clients with at least $10bn each. March31,2024 is a useful qualifier, not a separately asked fact.

reviews.reason: This is OCERS’ October 2022 custody-services RFP, not Missouri LAGERS’ private-markets-consultant RFP. Its public-pension client requirement concerns custody services and specifies different numbers and asset sizes; it does not support the requested non-discretionary consulting requirement.
quotes: The Orange County Employees Retirement System (“OCERS”) is requesting proposals from qualified firms with expertise in providing a comprehensive set of custody services.
Respondent must have at least five (5) defined benefit pension plan clients, of which two (2) are public pension plans with total plan assets of at least $25 billion each.
